_desc: Fill every field. Remove all _desc fields from your output. See GENERATION_GUIDE.md for rules.

starting_state.location_scene_id: string — scene id where a new playthrough begins

constants._desc: Layer A — always injected into every LLM prompt. ~200 tokens. World tone, era, cosmology, global political situation.

regions._desc: Layer B scope. Repeat this object for each region.
regions.name: string
regions.layer_b_text: string — ~300 tokens. Climate, culture, factions, political tension, geography.

zones._desc: Layer C scope — town, forest, dungeon, ruin. Repeat for each zone in this region.
zones.name: string
zones.type: string — e.g. town / forest / dungeon / ruin / port / camp
zones.layer_c_text: string — ~200 tokens. Local situation, reputation, landmarks, inhabitants.

scenes._desc: Layer D scope — a specific building, street, or outdoor location. Repeat for each scene in this zone.
scenes.name: string
scenes.type: string — e.g. tavern / market / alley / gate / shrine / shop / barracks
scenes.layer_d_text: string — ~200 tokens. Physical description, light, smell, sound, ambient mood.

group_entries.label: string — short identifier e.g. corner drinkers
group_entries.description: string — one sentence of sensory/behavioral detail

sub_scenes._desc: Rooms or sections within this scene. Optional. Repeat as needed.
sub_scenes.name: string
sub_scenes.layer_d_text: string — ~100 tokens. More specific than parent scene.

static_npcs._desc: Pre-authored World-Scoped NPCs. Repeat for each. Distribute across scenes via schedule.
static_npcs.name: string
static_npcs.role: string — social/political role e.g. town guard captain, merchant guild head
static_npcs.description: string — appearance and immediate impression in 2–3 sentences
static_npcs.personality: string — 2–3 dominant traits, how they speak and behave
static_npcs.faction: string or null — which faction they belong to
static_npcs._desc_relation: Starting relation score for all new characters. -100 (hostile) to +100 (loyal). 0 = neutral.

stats._desc: Relevant stats used by engine for difficulty calculations. Add or remove fields as needed.

schedule.scene_id: string — must match a scene id defined above

static_npcs.knowledge: string — what this NPC knows about the world, their faction, local secrets. Used by LLM for consistent dialogue.
